description: Archive a note, or bring one back. An archived note is out of the list but kept whole, still searchable, and returns with archived false. This is not deleting: nothing here deletes a note, which only the user can do, in the app.

archived.description: true to archive the note, false to bring it back from the archive. Defaults to true.

note_id.description: Note id, as returned by search_notes or list_notes.

name: scratchpad_archive_note
title: Archive note
